patch.value: Native Question investigations, linked hypotheses and Test facts with provenance and registered schema; SDK-only storage without git.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented registered hypothesis_state and immutable hypothesis_record fields, SDK-registered Question/Test types, native parent links and audit comments. Minimal SDK trackers omit Question/Test, so open registers them explicitly. Reads certify native record discovery and load the complete atomic owner.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Cross-investigation regression was red against the implementation commit: the global SDK unique-key guard conflated equal source payloads. Source envelopes now include their native id and owner, so identical titles with different operation identities, equal explanations and equal facts stay independent. The dedicated real-tracker scenario is green; no prior records or histories were rewritten.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Acquisition options are copied before async boundaries, and Store owns a copy of workspace/author/revision options. A record-written callback changing the caller evidence, time and actor cannot change the payload admitted from that source. The real SDK regression compares admitted provenance against the native source envelope. Reverting the acquisition snapshot fails this assertion.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Every public decision read now obtains an SDK owner/source snapshot and validates native type, parent, immutable payload schema, provenance and withdrawal/closure. Invalid observations cannot witness elimination, invalid hypotheses are explicit matrix rows and excluded from next requests, and active invalid sources refuse conclusion. Resume and show expose validity issues and invalidate historical conclusions whose sources no longer hold. No read repairs or rewrites native records.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof: npm run test:revert passed all 12 negative proofs in a disposable source copy. Reinstating create-before-validate makes the combined owner/source edit at record-read leave a fresh Test/history and fail durable byte equality. Bypassing current native source validation makes edited admitted provenance allow conclusion and fail the fixed case. Restoring owner retries that refresh captured sources fails the existing invocation-CAS regression. Each proof changes implementation only, requires a failing targeted regression, restores exact source bytes and removes its scratch copy. The two round-3 cases also failed on the prior committed implementation and pass with this change. Other retained proofs cover contradiction, withdrawal, survivor acknowledgment, discrimination, budgets, expected revisions, authoritative source reads, identity round trips and conclusion restoration.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Recorded targeted execution through pm test --run --only-last passes 15/15 tests, zero failures or skips: both fixed review cases plus all current source-schema, provenance, type, parent, withdrawal, closure, deletion, identity-alias, replay, owner-first interruption, history-absence, workspace-contention, omission and conclusion-validity cases. Native host restoration tests pass 3/3 and return invalid support, historical conclusions and the actual next request from each advertised show command. The 100-sample elimination-equivalence property now persists real native source records instead of dangling owner-only fixtures. Existing native SDK crash/interleaving suites pass 118/118.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Latest Node 22 CI passes all 1528 tests and 100/100/100/100 coverage across 18 source files, including the complete corrected 1312-case matrix. Packed npm/npx and Bun/bunx acceptance then fail at hypothesis open with an SDK refusal. Reproducing using an isolated packed consumer and inspecting the underlying exception only in disposable local diagnostics; public refusals remain sanitized. All other Node 22 release steps pass. No threshold or test scope will be reduced.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Packed root cause: SDK previewItemMutations rejects normal executable symlinks under managed extension dependencies with transaction_preview_non_regular_file. It has no public scope/exclusion option. Replaced full-tracker cloning with public resolveTransactionSchema, resolveRuntimeFieldRegistry and parseItemMutationBatch for schema-aware shape/field routing; all captured target checks, prepared-time revalidation, fenced sources and the single atomic commit remain. No links are followed, removed or modified. A real native tracker with a synthetic managed executable link fails before the change and passes after it; both fixed round-3 cases also remain green. This SDK preview gap will be reported in the final handoff, without upstream writes or a dependency bump.

value.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^managed extension executable|^atomic command:|^current source invariants:' test/source-validity.test.ts test/atomic-sources.test.ts

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Compatibility verification: npm run test:install passes 2/2 packed journeys (npm/npx and Bun/bunx), with no failure/skip; both execute open/add/observe/matrix/next/resume/conclude/withdraw plus in-process SDK reads from the tarball in nongit consumers. The tracker-linked managed-link and fixed-review regression command passes 3/3. The final disposable-copy revert run passes all 13 proofs, including restoration of the SDK whole-tracker preview, which fails the managed-link regression, and the create-before-validate, edited-provenance and source-dropping retry reversions. Exact implementation bytes are restored after every negative test and the scratch copy is removed. Typecheck, lint, zero duplication (0/3434 lines) and 69 documented declarations across 18 sources pass. New native batch validation changes only schema-aware planning; all owner/source CAS and atomic commit fences remain.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation now runs native SDK previewItemMutations on the exact commit batch. Types, field projections and status-role policy are captured through SDK registries and checked again with item preconditions. Missing Test, native required-field failures and incompatible field metadata refuse before source-tracker history writes. Source admission resolves registered aliases and all terminal roles; canonical replay compares stored owner declarations with requested declarations and returns declaration_mismatch with both digests. SDK/TOON/JSON data strings remain exact, including statement, reason and acquisition method; transport serialization owns escaping. Fixed regressions pass 8/8, including owner provenance, managed links and both original issue reproductions.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The PM-linked native/fixed suite passes 13 of 13; packed npm/npx and Bun/bunx journeys both pass. One older atomic/source linked command exceeded its existing 120-second limit during parallel model/coverage verification. Increased that command timeout to 600 seconds without changing assertions or gate thresholds; it will be rerun separately. Test-result tracking is disabled by tracker policy, so explicit comments retain results.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revert proof, native admission class: in a disposable copy, bypassed only validateBatch's native preview call; the missing-Test fixed case failed its durable byte comparison because apply admitted and compensated before the type error. Separately restored status acceptance for withdrawn native sources; the withdrawn-Question fixed case failed its expected typed refusal. Restored exact implementation bytes after each behavioral failure. The unchanged implementation passes both fixed cases; native required-field validation also leaves the tracker byte-identical.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revert proof, replay class: removed only add's canonical stored/requested owner declaration comparison. Both edited-statement and edited-prediction replays failed their expected declaration_mismatch assertions. With the comparison restored, equal reordered prediction declarations are no-ops and differing declarations return both digests with a repair remedy.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revert proof, structured-data class (issue 5): restored string escaping inside safe, leaving tests unchanged. The public next-to-observe fixed case failed its expected viable result. SDK data now remains exact and control-byte escaping occurs only in reversible JSON/TOON serialization; native item titles are display labels. Reverting only unbounded authoritative reads also fails the long-record regression, which otherwise proves three eliminations and one survivor without interpreting compacted SDK string summaries as domain records.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Additional class regressions pass: byte-distinct collating Unicode keys have one canonical replay intent; a missing native payload gives declaration_mismatch with both digests instead of an SDK TypeError; declarations are compared by canonical data, with digests serving only diagnostics. Removing canonical framing fails the missing-payload test, and removing the Unicode byte tie-break fails the replay identity test. Native bootstrap validates incompatible fields before setup, preserves removed types once installed, and recovers partial field setup. Reverting registry authority fails the no-schema-repair test. A terminal creation default refuses new records while leaving valid existing-source replays unchanged; its behavioral reversion also fails. Twenty baseline behavioral reversions plus these two selected new reversions have passed in disposable copies with exact restoration.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Exact-head Node 22 CI at 0e99c0c passes all 1622 tests; the gate correctly refuses branch coverage 99.76% (other dimensions 100%). Added meaningful missing cases: replay after explicit observation withdrawal remains a byte-identical no-op with no renewed eliminations; embedded fresh initialization carries create-only intent without an update match. Both pass. Also proved the native TOON codec rejects unpaired UTF-16 surrogates; data now refuses malformed Unicode before native storage, while preserving all valid Unicode without normalization. Four malformed-key/value admissions refuse without writes. Removing only that guard fails the regression, bringing behavioral reversions to 23. Targeted cases, typecheck, lint, docstrings and zero-duplication gate pass; full final-source CI rerun remains required.
